articles.title: Show HN: A small embeddable and hackable Lisp-2 interpreter in C
articles.summary: This news introduces an embeddable and hackable Lisp-2 interpreter, accessible online via a WebAssembly build. Such developments in programming language tools are crucial for software innovation and understanding fundamental computing principles, offering insights into modern technological advancements relevant to various fields, including defence applications requiring custom software solutions.
